text:
Nora F: FYI received invoice AS-4567 from Aurora Systems. PO shown on PDF is PO-55221 but the vendor used a legacy vendor code and our system didn't auto-route to the right approver. Invoice total $4,250. Vendor attached a scanned invoice (low-res).

Jin W: Can you paste invoice # and vendor reference? I'll try to reroute.

Nora F: Invoice AS-4567. Vendor ref VN-331. PO-55221 should route to @Jin W (Infra) but ProcureLink routed to Legacy-ops group.

AP Queue: Automated: invoice AS-4567 flagged as "approver_mismatch". Current routing group: legacy-ops. Expected approver: jin.w. Please confirm approver override or request vendor update.

Nora F: Also the scanned PDF is missing line-level quantities so OCR couldn't split charges by PO line. Looks like vendor printed PO on the bottom as image.

Aurora Systems Billing: Hi Nora, apologies. Our billing export used old vendor code 0912. We can either: 1) reissue invoice as AS-4567-R1 with PO in text and line details, or 2) confirm in writing that PO-55221 applies and you can route manually. Which do you prefer?

Jin W: For speed, we can manually override approver routing this time but need vendor to reissue for audit. AP please set temporary approver to jin.w and note vendor will reissue.

AP Queue: Done. AP action: set approver override to jin.w; invoice moved to "awaiting-approval" queue. Audit note: vendor to reissue invoice with PO as text and line details. If reissue not uploaded within 5 business days, AP will request vendor statement.

Nora F: I'll reply to vendor asking for a reissued PDF and ask them to include company code Redwood Inference v3 and GL mapping if possible.

Aurora Systems Billing: Will reissue today and upload link here. We'll include original invoice number plus R1 suffix and improved line detail.

Jin W: Thanks. Once reissued, I'll approve the Infra portion. Leaving note on PO-55221: "Temp override: jin.w; vendor reissue pending."

finance-bot: Record updated: AS-4567 status = awaiting_approval; override approver = Jin W; due_by = 2064042000.
